headline: September foreign exchange reserves hold above US$600 billion; central bank net sold US$17 billion in first half | Industry & Economy
summary: Taiwan's foreign exchange reserves stood at US$600.745 billion at end-September, down US$1.159 billion month on month. The central bank net sold US$4.45 billion in the second quarter.
why: Central bank reserves signal the capacity to intervene in currency markets, and Taiwan's reserves are closely watched given the island's trade-dependent economy.
